name: Buzzcutter
prompt: Buzzcutter — a brutal circular-buzzsaw sword, a spinning toothed steel disc mounted on a stubby industrial haft, sparks + sawdust flinging off the whirring teeth.

name: Drowned Anchor
prompt: Drowned Anchor — a massive barnacle-crusted ship's anchor swung as a greatsword, rusted iron flukes trailing kelp and brine, immense and blunt.

name: Reaper's Lid
prompt: Reaper's Lid — a coffin-lid slab wielded as a greatblade, weathered nailed planks edged in cold iron, funereal and heavy.

name: Spike Driver
prompt: Spike Driver — a rail-spike maul-sword, a long iron railroad spike forged into a piercing blade on a hammer haft, industrial and merciless.

name: Voltedge
prompt: Voltedge — a neon-lit katana, its monomolecular blade crackling with electric-cyan energy along a hairline edge, sleek and futuristic.

name: Wyrmtooth
prompt: Wyrmtooth — a jagged fang-blade carved from a dragon's tooth, ivory bone serrated and cruel with a sinew-wrapped grip, primal.

name: Revolver Cannon
prompt: Revolver Cannon — an oversized break-action hand cannon, a fat rotating cylinder and a stubby wide muzzle, hefty gunmetal with brass fittings, smoking.

name: Coffin Shotgun
prompt: Coffin Shotgun — a sawn-off double-barrel shotgun clad in coffin-wood and iron nails, funereal and blunt, wisps of powder-smoke at the muzzles.

name: Gatling
prompt: Gatling — a hand-cranked multi-barrel gatling gun, a spinning cluster of gunmetal barrels on a brass frame, belt-fed and ferocious, muzzle glow.

name: Nailgun
prompt: Nailgun — a pneumatic industrial nailgun repurposed as a weapon, a boxy body with a nail magazine and a compressed-air hose, spitting bright nails.

name: Ricochet Pistol
prompt: Ricochet Pistol — a sleek trick-shot revolver with a polished chrome barrel and angled deflector fins, rounds sparking off ricochet lines, showy.
